notes: Judicial candidates; bar ratings excluded. Only campaign-site philosophy statements and notable endorsements recorded.

maria-ghobadi.text: Campaign themes are "Public Safety. Equal Justice": says she understands the balance between protecting the public and upholding the constitutional rights of the accused, and pursued "justice, not simply convictions."
Endorsed by the Los Angeles Police Protective League and the Los Angeles Association of Deputy District Attorneys.
Endorsed by the LA County Democratic Party, SEIU 721, IBEW Local 11 and Ironworkers.

rhonda-a-haymon.text: "Justice must honor both the spirit and the letter of the law. Fairness, due process, and ethical decision-making are not optional."
"Justice should restore dignity and strengthen communities"; campaign tagline: "Bringing empathy, experience and compassion to the bench."
